requirement_text.REQ-396: Add HUMAN_TASK.escalation_timer_duration to graph schema and wire SCH-04 escalation half. WHAT EXISTS: POST /instances/:id/advance-timer force-fires TIMER nodes; Letflow.Definitions.Graph validates :TIMER with duration_iso8601 (CHK-12). WHAT DOES NOT EXIST: No timeout on :HUMAN_TASK that (a) races the human, (b) makes original task non-actionable, (c) creates new task assigned to escalation role. SCOPE: CODE-DESIGNER decides schema shape (escalation_timer_duration + escalation_role on :HUMAN_TASK, OR boundary-timer node approach reusing existing :TIMER/:GATEWAY primitives); ELIXIR-DEV wires Engine/Scheduler; update process_route_approval.yaml. NOT IN SCOPE: REQ-185/186/187/188 recurring timers; REQ-395 live deployment; ISS-0739 credentials. ACs: design doc citing REQ-185/REQ-188 blocker closed; Graph validates new attributes with test rejecting malformed; ExUnit proves timer fire -> (a) non-actionable, (b) one new task to escalation role, (c) audit ordering; process_route_approval.yaml updated; mix test + compile pass.
